sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 29.04.2022.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the father of the applicant is facing medical problem in left knee and the same is required to be operated.
The applicant is ready to deposit Rs.25000/- cash security before the trial Court.
It is also submitted that earlier also the applicant was granted temporary bail and he has not misused the same.
Hence, interim bail may be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12428 2 MCRC-19553-2025 granted to the applicant for a period of 45 days.
3 . Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case diary.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid submissions and on perusal of the documents filed on record, this Court is inclined to allow the present temporary bail application for a period of 30 days from the date of his release.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on temporary bail for a period of 30 days from the date of his release upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.

It is made clear that after having been completed the aforesaid period, the applicant may surrender before the Trial Court, failing which the concerned trial Court is having liberty to arrest the applicant in accordance with law.

8. The amount of Rs.25000/- shall be returned to the applicant after surrender before the trial Court.
